 Dated this the 06th day of February, 2025  JUDGMENT Admit.
Government Pleader takes notice for respondents.
2. The petitioners are aggrieved by the steps that have been taken to dispossess them from their properties under the guise of acquisition for improvement of the Vellayani Lake.
The petitioners have preferred Ext.P2 representation before the 5th respondent and seek an early disposal of the same.

3. In view of the limited prayer made, this writ petition is disposed of directing the 5th respondent to consider and pass orders on Ext.P2 representation, after hearing the petitioners or their representatives, at the earliest, at any rate within two months from the date of WP(C) NO. 4832 OF 2025 2025:KER:9878 receipt of a copy of this judgment.

The petitioners may not be dispossessed in Sivan Kutty Nair vs State Of Kerala on 6 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89929480/
